title: DIY Patchwork Apron
seo_title: DIY Patchwork Apron Sewing Workshop at The Farmstead
description: This is a sewing workshop where you learn to use a sewing machine and make your own patchwork apron, with step-by-step guidance from Alison Hamby of In the Light Quilts. No sewing experience is needed, and all materials, machines, and tools are provided. It takes place Saturday, November 21, 2026, from 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM at The Farmstead.
